text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, asked to lend a hand with 
something, I went out shopping with Casino 
Drive.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth... I received a letter 
from "that person." A letter of 
encouragement, sent to me all the way here 
in Japan.
choice_data_list: By "that person," do you mean...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she achieved so much at such a young 
age... She's someone I truly admire.
choice_data_list: “あの方”って……
choice_data_list_en: 'That person' meaning...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
As a token of my gratitude, I would like 
to reply on traditional Japanese 
stationery... Do you happen to know a good 
shop?
choice_data_list: I see, in that case――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
This is amazing! It has a much more 
traditional Japanese taste than other 
stationery shops……!
choice_data_list: なるほど、それなら――
choice_data_list_en: I see, in that case—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Trainer, what is that card? It 
seems to be folded up, but...
choice_data_list: Hehehe, once you open this――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! This is…… a Japanese festival! It's 
a pop-up message card.
choice_data_list: ふっふっふ、これを開くと――
choice_data_list_en: Hehehe, and when you open this—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Letter paper made from Japanese washi... 
Excellent. The floral drawing underneath 
is lovely too—oh?
choice_data_list: 品揃えも豊富だぞ！いろいろ見てみよう！
品揃えも豊富だよ！いろいろ見てみよう！
choice_data_list_en: They have a huge selection, too! Let's take a look around!
They have a huge selection, too! Let's take a look around!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
This flower is different from the one we 
saw earlier…… A different pattern, 
perhaps? My, this is quite a dilemma.
choice_data_list:
Do you have a particular preference for 
floral patterns?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
――The language of flowers. Actually, some 
flowers have different meanings in Japan 
compared to America.
choice_data_list: もしかして、花の柄にこだわりが？
choice_data_list_en: Are you particular about floral patterns?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. For such important letter paper, I 
want to make a balanced choice based on 
the floral languages of both countries. In 
that case――
choice_data_list: えっ、そうなのか？
えっ、そうなの？
choice_data_list_en: Wait, is that so?
Wait, really?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I will research the floral language of 
every pattern. Separately for Japan and 
America.
choice_data_list:
What?! There are like 30 different 
patterns?!

What?! There are like 30 different 
patterns?!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
No problem. Research like this is my 
forte, so I won't take up much of your 
time. Besides――
choice_data_list: え！？柄違い、30個くらいあるぞ！？
え！？柄違い、30個くらいあるよ！？
choice_data_list_en: Huh?! There are about 30 different patterns?!
Huh?! There are about 30 different patterns?!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
It is a gift for "that person." I want 
every single detail to be immaculate, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Well then, would you mind waiting for me? 
It should only take about thirty minutes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of us looked up the 
language of flowers... and ultimately 
bought cherry blossom-patterned 
stationery.
choice_data_list: いやいや、俺も手伝うよ！
いやいや、私も手伝うよ！
choice_data_list_en: No, no, I'll help too!
No, no, I'll help too!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your help. Thanks to 
you, it looks like it'll make a wonderful 
present.
choice_data_list:
I'm sure your senior will be thrilled, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I only hope it serves as some 
repayment. They truly took such good care 
of me, after all.
choice_data_list: 先輩も、きっと喜んでくれるよ
choice_data_list_en: I'm sure Senpai will be happy too.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Rather than a mentor... she was truly my 
hero. She showed my young self the path I 
ought to follow.
choice_data_list: 師匠みたいな感じ？
choice_data_list_en: Kind of like a master?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
The day after "that person" won a certain 
graded race... She came over and spoke to 
me――

text_block_list.name: That Person
text_block_list.text:
"Casino, did I hear you won the kids' race 
yesterday? That's amazing!"

text_block_list.name: That Person
text_block_list.text:
"You truly do have talent. There will 
surely be much expected of you moving 
forward."

text_block_list.name: That Person
text_block_list.text:
"Keep on challenging yourself, Casino! 
Take on every expectation and hurdle, and 
break right through! If you do that――"

text_block_list.name: That Person
text_block_list.text:
"You can become the greatest Umamusume in 
the world!"

text_block_list.name: That Person
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not joking, I'm absolutely certain! 
I'll be waiting for you... out on the 
turf!"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—A brilliance as dazzling as the sun. Even 
now, I can never forget it.
choice_data_list: She really looks up to her, doesn't she?
She really looks up to her, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, after that, 'she' racked up graded 
stakes win after win... and became a true 
star.
choice_data_list: 本当に、憧れの人なんだな
本当に、憧れの人なんだね
choice_data_list_en: You really look up to her, don't you?
She really is your idol, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Her back as she performs has always been 
my guiding light. That overwhelming power, 
and the spirit that weaves the future—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: That's seriously so cool!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Her race footage is absolutely the 
coolest! Powerful, with a stride that 
shakes the very earth!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Like a shooting star blazing across the 
sand! When I was little, I'd try to 
imitate her stride and everything――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I've repeated the DVD over and over again, 
too! Let's watch it together next time, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Casino Drive seemed somewhat brighter than 
usual. With her sparkling expression, she 
looked just like an innocent child.
choice_data_list: Haha…… You must really love it.
Fufu…… You must really love it.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
choice_data_list: ははっ……よっぽど好きなんだな
ふふっ……よっぽど好きなんだね
choice_data_list_en: Haha... you must really like it.
Hehe... You must really like it.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
――In short, we should look to overseas 
races for reference. I am certain it will 
grant us new knowledge.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Daily study is crucial, and from now on, I 
must deepen my analysis from a worldwide 
perspective.
choice_data_list: えっ？
choice_data_list_en: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
And feeding those absorbed methods back 
into your assigned Umamusume is your 
mission. ――Understood?
choice_data_list: U-Understood...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought I had caught a glimpse 
of a rare side of her... she immediately 
returned to her usual self.
choice_data_list: わ、わかりました……！
choice_data_list_en: U-Understood...!
